visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide, high-angle shot of a lush green park where a large, sprawling tree with dense green foliage stands prominently in the center. A young man is seen sitting cross-legged on a tan mat under the tree's wide canopy, holding a melodica. His hands are positioned on the keys, and his facial expression is calm as he prepares to play. The background consists of a grassy field, a winding path, and distant buildings in a hazy urban skyline under bright, natural overcast lighting. (2) The camera slowly zooms in on the man as he begins his performance. His facial features become clearer, showing a look of quiet concentration, and his fingers move with precision across the black and white keys of the melodica. The instrument is held steadily in his hands. The setting is intimate, focused on the man and the massive trunk of the tree behind him, which provides a natural textured backdrop. The lighting remains bright and consistent, emphasizing the vibrant green of the grass and leaves. (3) The man transitions into a lying position on the mat while continuing to play the melodica vertically above his face. The shot becomes a close-up, highlighting the movement of his fingers and the soft expression on his face as he looks up at the instrument. He eventually lies completely flat on his back on the tan mat, legs relaxed. The environment under the tree remains serene and isolated from the distant city, with no other characters or objects disturbing the scene.
